briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind escalate frontier model releases as multi-agent systems proliferate

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has intensified with new model launches from major labs and record quarterly funding. Regulatory scrutiny grows alongside rapid capability gains in reasoning and multi-agent coordination.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with advanced agentic workflows while Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus demonstrated superior long-context performance. Google and Meta rolled out incremental updates focused on efficiency.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across automotive and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced new 100k H100-equivalent clusters in Europe and Asia. NVIDIA's Blackwell ramp continues with TSMC reporting record AI chip yields.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight model proliferation outpace closed-lab safety measures by end of 2026?
